PATTERN_MATCH_DECISION_RULE.classification: DESCRIPTIVE / EXPLORATORY -- bootstrap CIs reported (n_boot=20000, alpha=0.05, rng_seed=7) but this is not a confirmatory LCB95 gate and must not be labeled FIXED_ATTACK_HEAVY_6V6_CONFIRMED. A pattern_match=TRUE result licenses a PI decision about confirmatory n and about whether heuristic composition + learned behaviors is the next bridge; it does not authorize pi_D training by itself. A pattern_match=FALSE result, under this frozen reading, is evidence that assignment-rule rescue of the old scripted contrast failed and that the old 6v6 learned policies (not just FIXED_IDENTITY) are the bottleneck -- escalate; do not auto-train pi_D.
